title: The Lost Charm
description: Mireille's lucky charm went missing in the plaza. Help her find it.

offer: Oh no, oh no... my lucky charm is gone!
I had it a minute ago. Could you help me look for it?
accept: Thank you! Rene over by the trees might have seen something.
decline: Oh... all right. Come back if you change your mind.
done: My charm, whole again! Thank you so much.
Please, take these for your trouble.
after: I'll never let it out of my sight again!

steps.text: Ask Rene by the trees about the charm
lines: A charm? I saw a Fletchling fly off with something shiny.
It went towards the street corner over there.
Feathers... the charm must have broken into pieces!
A Fletchling! So that's who took it... it just liked the shine.
The pieces only fit back together under the night sky. Come back tonight?
missing: Do you have a Fletchling with you? I'd love to see one.

lines: Night has fallen - the charm pieces are glowing!
